pergunta: What was Deborah's mom passionate about?

focused_selection.text:
Session date: 4:06 pm on 23 January, 2023
[D1:6] Jolene: Sorry about your loss, Deb. My mother also passed away last year. This is my room in her house, I also have many memories there. Is there anything special about it you remember?
[D1:7] Deborah: My mom's house had a special bench near the window. She loved to sit there every morning and take in the view. I come to sit here sometimes, it helps me stay connected to her.
[D1:8] Jolene: Staying connected is super important. Do you have something to remember her by? This pendant reminds me of my mother, she gave it to me in 2010  in Paris.
[...]
[D1:12] Jolene: Do you have goals?
[D1:13] Deborah: One of my goals is to keep teaching yoga and supporting my community. I'm passionate about helping people find peace and joy through it.
[D1:14] Jolene: What inspired you to go down this route?
[D1:15] Deborah: Yoga helped me find peace during a rough time, and now I'm passionate about sharing that with others.
[D1:16] Jolene: It is truly inspiring!
[...]
Session date: 9:49 am on 27 January, 2023
[D2:8] Jolene: What touching words! Who is this letter from?
[D2:9] Deborah: The group members sent this to me! They thanked me for the positive influence I had on them. Those moments remind me why I'm so passionate about yoga.
[D2:10] Jolene: Where do you most often do yoga?
[...]
[D2:12] Jolene: Where is it?
[D2:13] Deborah: That's my old home. I go there now and then for my mom, who passed away. Sitting in that spot by the window gives me peace.
[D2:14] Jolene: Must be great to have that place where you feel connected to her.

Session date: 9:03 pm on 9 February, 2023
[D5:4] Deborah: You deserve credit for stepping outside your comfort zone and believing in yourself. What cool stuff did you accomplish at the retreat?
[D5:5] Jolene: I really accomplished something with my engineering project - I came up with some neat solutions and I'm really excited about it.
[D5:6] Deborah: Let's go into more detail.
[...]
Session date: 4:12 pm on 22 February, 2023
[D6:4] Deborah: The roses and dahlias bring me peace. I lost a friend last week, so I've been spending time in the garden to find some comfort.
[D6:5] Jolene: Sorry to hear about your friend, Deb. Losing someone can be really tough. How are you holding up?
[D6:6] Deborah: Thanks for the kind words. It's been tough, but I'm comforted by remembering our time together. It reminds me of how special life is.
[...]
Session date: 4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023
[D7:9] Jolene: We actually met in an engineering class in college and quickly became friends. It eventually blossomed into something more and it's been great!
[D7:10] Deborah: Wow, your relationship started from a strong friendship. Do you still enjoy working on engineering projects together?
[D7:11] Jolene: Yep, teaming up for these projects feels great! We get each other's struggles and both love it.
[D7:12] Deborah: Have yoga or meditation helped with any stress?
[D7:13] Jolene: Whenever I'm overwhelmed, I just take a break and do some breathing or meditate. It really helps me feel calmer and clearer, so I'm able to handle challenges more easily.
[D7:14] Deborah: It's been great to see your progress since we last chatted - keep it up!
[D7:15] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and continue taking time for myself.

Session date: 9:26 am on 1 August, 2023
[D16:14] Jolene: This room looks perfect for it. Do you have any favorite routines you can share?
[D16:15] Deborah: One of my favorite yoga routines is a gentle flow that's all about breathing and grounding. It helps me find my chill. I'll send you a tutorial video with the poses. This is me in the process :)
[D16:16] Jolene: Wow! Does that help you find your chill or improve your concentration?
[...]
[D16:20] Jolene: Yep, I'll practice and update you. Bye!
Session date: 8:50 pm on 12 August, 2023
[D17:1] Deborah: Since we last spoke, I made a meditation guide for my yoga retreat. How about you?
[D17:2] Jolene: I have been stressed since I lost my work files. I was so overwhelmed...but meditation kept me chill and I got my clarity back, thank goodness. Really appreciate the practice!
[...]
[D17:8] Jolene: Seeing art and design in various things gives me a unique perspective on problems.
[D17:9] Deborah: Got any neat projects or ideas you're pumped about?
[D17:10] Jolene:  Working on a cool project now - a prototype that could revolutionize aerial surveillance. Can't wait to see the results!
[...]
Session date: 2:58 pm on 16 August, 2023
[D18:15] Jolene: Thanks, I'll hit you up if I need anything. Bye for now.
Session date: 12:52 am on 19 August, 2023
[D19:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Hope you're having a good one. Last Friday I told Anna the story of my life and they were super kind about it. It was so nice to have a meaningful connection. How's the mindfulness workshops and reading going? Need any help?
[D19:2] Jolene: Life's been hella busy since we last talked. I bought a console for my partner as a gift on the 17th and it's so much fun, he even managed to play it.! Engineering studies are still going strong too. Balance has been key for me lately. How about you? What's been up?

Session date: 1:24 pm on 17 September, 2023
[D29:28] Jolene: I already know what fate awaits me if I do this!
[D29:29] Deborah: Have you ever been interested in this or do you know nothing about it?
[D29:30] Jolene: Just started learning, but haven't gone yet. Want to come with me sometime?
[...]
[D29:34] Jolene: Let's plan for next month - I'll check my schedule and let you know. Can't wait!
Session date: 10:17 am on 20 September, 2023
[D30:1] Deborah: I had a great time at the music festival with my pals! The vibes were unreal and the music was magical. It was so freeing to dance and bop around. Music brings us together and helps us show our feelings. It reminds me of my mom and her soothing voice when she'd sing lullabies to me. Lucky to have those memories!
[D30:2] Jolene: Wow, festivals sound so fun! Here's me and my partner at one last year - had an awesome time! It's my way of expressing myself and getting away from all the stress of everyday life. Just got back from a trip with my partner - so cool!
[...]
[D30:12] Jolene: That sounds magical! How was it watching the tree bloom each spring?
[D30:13] Deborah: It was like admiring nature's artwork. It filled me with awe and made me appreciate the beauty of life. Even in tough times, there's hope for growth.
[D30:14] Jolene: This photo I took is a great visual representation of that idea. It reminds me that I can keep growing through any obstacles.
[D30:15] Deborah: It really captures resilience and strength. I love how you find inspiration in the small things.
[D30:16] Jolene: Thanks, Deborah! Appreciating those small things is important. It helps me remember that even when times are tough, there's always something positive to hang onto.
[D30:17] Deborah: It's a great habit. Thanks for reminding me!
[D30:18] Jolene: Sure Deb, it's great catching up. Keep on finding those beauties!

Session date: 7:03 pm on 1 February, 2023
[D3:9] Jolene: Sounds great!
[D3:10] Deborah: Have you ever thought about resuming yoga?

Session date: 9:48 am on 4 February, 2023
[D4:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Good to hear from you. How've you been? I've been on an emotional rollercoaster lately, but I'm coping.
[D4:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you. All good here - how about you? Anything new happening lately?
[D4:3] Jolene: I had a major milestone last week and it went really well - I'm so relieved and proud. It was a huge accomplishment for me as an engineer.
[D4:4] Deborah: That's awesome. You must have worked really hard for that. I'm so proud of you. Care to share more about it?
[D4:5] Jolene: Thanks so much! I had to plan and research a lot to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need. It was tough, but I loved the experience.
[...]
[D4:20] Deborah: That's quite a collection! Have you had a favorite book lately? I'd love to hear your thoughts.
[D4:21] Jolene: Thanks Deborah! I'm really into this book called "Sapiens" - it's a fascinating look at human history and how technology has affected us. It's giving me a lot to think about!
[D4:22] Deborah: Great, this is interesting! Have you come across any recent ones that really struck you?
[...]
[D4:33] Jolene: Here's a picture I took on vacation last summer in Bogota. It was so beautiful and calming watching the sunset over the water. It definitely made me appreciate nature's calming power.
[D4:34] Deborah: That sounds great, Jolene. Nature's calming for sure. Guess it helps us forget the daily craziness and find inner peace. No wonder you're a fan! I like to come to this spot by the water near my mom's old house. It's where I reflect on her life and find some peace. Being surrounded by nature helps a lot.
[D4:35] Jolene: That's so touching! Do you have any little traditions that you do when you come to reflect on your mom?
